claim: CAISO's 2026-10-30 second revised draft tariff language is listed by the primary stakeholder site but its full DOCX text was not inspected in this run. A web document reader rejected the .docx content type and a separate isolated container download failed at DNS resolution. Neither failure establishes that the document is unavailable to the public, invalid, or inconsistent with the October 22 CAISO board memorandum. Do not infer final tariff language from a board press release.
